title.value: Reincarnating Reinforcement Learning: Reusing Prior Computation to Accelerate Progress
title.justification: The paper discusses the concept of reincarnating reinforcement learning by reusing prior computation to enhance the efficiency and democratization of reinforcement learning applications.
title.quote: Title: Reincarnating Reinforcement Learning: Reusing Prior Computation to Accelerate Progress

extractions.description: The paper presents reincarnating reinforcement learning (RRL), an approach to reuse prior computational work in reinforcement learning instead of starting from scratch. This approach seeks to leverage existing policies and learned data to accelerate the training of RL agents, making RL research more accessible to institutions with limited computational resources. The paper focuses on policy-to-value reincarnating RL and introduces a new method, QDagger, demonstrating its effectiveness in various settings such as Atari games and real-world problems like navigation of stratospheric balloons.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: Reincarnating RL directly addresses reducing computational costs, making RL more environmentally friendly and accessible, thus supporting sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Reincarnating RL could positively impact society by reducing the computational burden on researchers and is more environment friendly than tabula rasa RL.

primary_category.justification: The paper emphasizes reducing computational resources, which aligns with climate change mitigation efforts by potentially lowering the energy consumption associated with large-scale training of RL models.
primary_category.quote: Reincarnating RL could positively impact society by reducing the computational burden on researchers and is more environment friendly than tabula rasa RL.

secondary_categories.justification: By democratizing access to efficient RL methods, the paper supports Global South initiatives by enabling more researchers to participate without industrial-scale resources.
secondary_categories.quote: reincarnating RL makes it more accessible to the wider research community, enabling those without sufficient compute resources to build upon prior computational work.

primary_sub_category.justification: Although indirect, the focus on reducing computational resources can contribute to energy-efficient practices in computational processes, analogous to energy efficiency efforts in buildings.

applications.justification: The paper specifically mentions using reincarnating RL approaches for tasks such as navigating stratospheric balloons, demonstrating a practical application of the research.
applications.quote: reincarnating RL gains over tabula rasa RL on Atari 2600 games, a challenging locomotion task, and the real-world problem of navigating stratospheric balloons.
